result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback position: it imposes a mutual, agreement-wide cap based on 12 months of paid or payable fees and includes the minimum required uncapped carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, and willful misconduct. The additional preferred carve-outs and exclusion of Client payment obligations are playbook-aligned and do not unnecessarily alter unrelated commercial terms. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits the USD 1,000,000 floor and a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages. Drafting could also be improved by specifying that the 12-month lookback precedes the event giving rise to the claim and by framing payment obligations as not constituting damages rather than merely exempting them from the cap.
